variants.name: Nostalgia D.M.T.R.
variants.description:
Code: D.M.T.R.
Grade: Heretic
Generation: Dark Matter

1553701.name: Light that Protected
1553701.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1553702.name: Bullets Meant to Protect
1553702.description: Fires machine gun shots at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

1553704.name: Memories that Sparkled
1553704.description: Shoots Memories that Sparkled, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes. This attack can be intercepted.

1553705.name: Days that Glimmered
1553705.description: Gathers energy and then fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1553706.name: Precious Wings
1553706.description: Creates a burst of wind, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Destroy the parts within the time limit to interrupt the attack.

1553707.name: A Gaze that Inspired Hope
1553707.description: Shoots a Gaze that Inspired Hope, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be afflicted with the Pressure debuff, a stackable effect that increases damage taken. This attack can be intercepted.

1553708.name: The Shining Light that Was Us
1553708.description: Emits waves of light, dealing damage to all Nikkes. This attack pierces the cover of Nikkes afflicted with the Pressure debuff, dealing damage and reducing the stacks of Pressure.

1553711.name: Power that Protected Humanity I
1553711.description: Pierces cover and deals massive damage to all Nikkes.

1553712.name: Power that Protected Humanity II
1553712.description:
Pierces cover and deals massive damage to all Nikkes.
Nostalgia generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Power that Protected Humanity II. While the barrier is up, only Wind Code Nikkes can deal damage.
